audience: developers and creators who run AI image and video models on fal.ai

useCases.title: Find a model by keyword
useCases.text: Searches the fal.ai model registry by keywords, page by page, and lists matching models, for example for images or short video.

useCases.title: Check which inputs a model needs
useCases.text: Reads the model's OpenAPI schema and explains its input and output fields, so you know what to send before you run it.

useCases.title: Run a model and get the result
useCases.text: Runs a model with your input, waits until it is done and returns the result. If it takes too long, you get a request id to keep checking.

useCases.title: Queue a request and follow its progress
useCases.text: Submits a request to the queue and returns at once with a request id. Then checks its status (in queue, in progress, completed) and fetches the result.

useCases.title: Cancel a queued request that has not started
useCases.text: Asks to cancel a request that is still in the queue. Checks its status first, because a started request cannot be cancelled this way.
